key_highlights: ASX supported by heavyweight mining sector despite sharp Wall Street volatility post-US midterms.
ANZ delivers $7.6b full-year profit, though rising home loan arrears highlight growing credit risk.
Australian housing market confronts record downturn under restrictive RBA monetary policy.
AUD/USD depreciation accelerates alongside sluggish crude oil and cautious iron ore pricing.

sectors.trend: Iron ore remains fragile while gold exploration and critical minerals projects advance in WA.
sectors.implications: Diversified majors anchor index performance; selective opportunities in high-grade gold and rare earths.

sectors.trend: Robust headline bank profits offset by rising mortgage delinquencies and household cash flow strain.
sectors.implications: Potential escalation in loan-loss provisioning and margin compression across major residential mortgage books.

sectors.trend: Global oil recovery faces extended headwinds, while domestic natural gas exploration clears key licensing hurdles.
sectors.implications: Subdued near-term oil earnings contrast with strategic value in domestic gas supply infrastructure.

sectors.trend: Accelerating residential property downturn and retail department store instability pressure asset valuations.
sectors.implications: Increased vacancy risk and potential cap rate expansion for retail mall REITs.

sectors.trend: Department store restructuring and household spending contraction amid aggressive RBA rate tightening.
sectors.implications: Discretionary retailers face margin squeeze ahead of key holiday trading; preference remains for defensive consumer staples.

key_themes: Divergence between resource exporters benefiting from weak AUD and debt-stressed domestic sectors.
RBA monetary policy transmission exacerbating mortgage arrears and nationwide housing declines.
Global equity re-pricing and US political uncertainty filtering into Australian market volatility.

risk_assessment.mitigation: Underweight high-leverage retail lenders; favour banks with diversified corporate and institutional books.
Overweight USD-denominated revenue earners such as global miners and healthcare exporters.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Global Equity Sell-off Contagion Post-US Midterms
risk_assessment.mitigation: Maintain elevated cash allocations and deploy defensive index hedging strategies.

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Department Store Tenant Distress in Retail REITs
risk_assessment.mitigation: Rotate exposure from regional retail malls into industrial logistics and necessity-anchored assets.

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight large-cap diversified miners and gold producers.
opportunities.rationale: Strong balance sheets and USD-denominated revenues provide resilient cash flows and inflation protection.

opportunities.recommendation: Target domestic gas developers securing critical regulatory approvals.
opportunities.rationale: Northern Territory gas licensing milestones enhance project certainty for long-term domestic energy shortfalls.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to retail banking majors sensitive to residential mortgage stress.
defensive_moves.rationale: Rising 90-day delinquency rates and property price declines threaten credit growth and provisioning charges.

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight shopping mall REITs vulnerable to department store downsizing.
defensive_moves.rationale: Potential anchor tenant rationalisation threatens rental income streams and asset capitalisation rates.

market_outlook.short_term: Range-bound ASX 200 trading as commodity resilience offsets global equity turbulence and domestic consumer weakness.
market_outlook.long_term: Economic slowdown driven by property downturn and household deleveraging will likely force an RBA policy pivot.
key_catalysts: RBA cash rate decisions and monetary policy statements
China property sector stimulus and steel production quotas
APRA quarterly banking credit quality and mortgage arrears data
US Federal Reserve interest rate path post-midterms
watch_list: Dalian and Singapore iron ore benchmark contracts
